note: 42nd St crowds, arcade patrons, hotel-bar regulars, hustlers (implied).

lines.text: Hey, man. Hey. You want to see a movie? Three features, one dollar.
Evening, chief.
Kung fu, kung fu, horror, kung fu. That's the whole marquee.
Sleep in the movies. Cheapest hotel in town.
Got a watch. Real gold. Real-ish. Real enough.
Pinball's rigged. Everything's rigged. Still, a quarter's a quarter.
Cops sweep at midnight. Be somewhere else at midnight.
Projector broke halfway. No refunds. This is America.
Hot dog was ninety cents. Ninety! For a hot dog!
Rain on the Deuce. Even the neon looks sad.
Duck in the arcade, man. Rain's free, shelter's a quarter.
It's cooler in the movies. Even the bad ones.
Honk at the Deuce? Nobody here's going anywhere!
Yeah, honk! We love music on Forty-Second!
Watch it! You almost made me drop my hot dog!
Easy. Wallet's still here. Yours? Check yours.
Run, man! Who's behind you? Don't tell me.
Running on Forty-Second? Either a cop or the reason for one.
Get that car off the curb, you lunatic!
Marquees went dark! The whole Deuce went dark!
Lights out on Forty-Second. Finally looks honest.
Three a.m. and the Deuce is still awake. Always awake.
Earl's number today? Seven-four-one, I heard.
Shine your shoes, mister? Earl's the best on the street.
Bauer's arcade. Ten games, nine broken, one fixed. Guess which.
You look like you need a seat in the dark for six hours.
Usher woke me up. Paid a dollar to get woke up.
Times Square used to have class. Now it has character.
Bus station's warm. Bus station's always warm.
Hey! Ever heard of a sidewalk? This is one.
Radios, radios! Fell off a truck! The truck's fine!
Hey, my man's back. You buying or browsing?
You ran that creep off Forty-Second. You're good on this block.
You took from Ray's till. Ray remembers. Ray always remembers.
Look at the hero. Go home, hero. This street eats heroes.
You shot up the Deuce, you don't come back to the Deuce.
Whoa! Whoa, I got nothing! I'm a businessman! Small business!
Not me, man. I'm just standing here. Standing is legal.
